```plato
//==
// # Quantities
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Dynamic units
//  - Electromagnetic quantities
//  - Geometric quantities
//  - Kinematic quantities
//  - Material-response and flow quantities
//  - Mechanical quantities
//  - Photometric and radiometric quantities
//  - Thermal and chemical quantities

//==
// # Dynamic units
//
// Unit systems resolved at runtime rather than by type (file import, UI,
// scientific data). A `Dimension` is the exponent vector over the seven SI base
// dimensions (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SI_base_unit), a `UnitOfMeasure`
// pairs a dimension with an affine conversion to SI, and a `DynamicQuantity` is
// an amount tagged with such a unit.

// Exponents of the seven SI base dimensions
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dimensional_analysis). A dimensionless value
// has all zeros.
type Dimension
{
    LengthPower: Integer;
    MassPower: Integer;
    TimePower: Integer;
    CurrentPower: Integer;
    TemperaturePower: Integer;
    AmountPower: Integer;
    LuminosityPower: Integer;
}
```
